role_permission_scope.title: Role Permission Scope
role_permission_scope.description: Indicates whether roles are defined with minimal, appropriate, or excessive permissions relative to their function

wildcard_permissions_present.title: Wildcard Permissions Present
wildcard_permissions_present.description: Whether any role grants wildcard or catch-all permissions (e.g., *, admin:*, all) that exceed specific function needs

privilege_review_frequency.title: Privilege Review Frequency
privilege_review_frequency.description: How frequently role-permission assignments are reviewed and recertified to ensure continued least-privilege compliance

separation_of_duties_enforced.title: Separation of Duties Enforced
separation_of_duties_enforced.description: Whether the RBAC model prevents any single role from holding conflicting high-privilege permissions (e.g., both approver and executor)

over_privileged_user_count.title: Over-Privileged User Count
over_privileged_user_count.description: Number of users currently assigned to roles that exceed their functional requirements, as identified by access reviews or automated tooling

role_review_process_exists.title: Role Review Process Exists
role_review_process_exists.description: Whether a formal periodic review process exists to validate that user role assignments reflect current organizational responsibilities

role_review_frequency_days.title: Role Review Frequency (Days)
role_review_frequency_days.description: Maximum number of days between scheduled role assignment reviews

orphaned_role_assignments_remediated.title: Orphaned Role Assignments Remediated
orphaned_role_assignments_remediated.description: Whether there is a confirmed process or control that detects and removes role assignments for inactive, terminated, or transferred users

rbac_enforcement_scope.title: RBAC Enforcement Scope
rbac_enforcement_scope.description: Indicates whether role-based access control gates are applied to all application actions, only some, or none

unprotected_action_count.title: Unprotected Action Count
unprotected_action_count.description: The number of application actions or endpoints that are accessible without a role-based access control check

default_deny_policy_enabled.title: Default Deny Policy Enabled
default_deny_policy_enabled.description: Whether the RBAC system uses a default-deny posture, blocking any action not explicitly permitted by a role assignment

bypass_mechanisms_present.title: Bypass Mechanisms Present
bypass_mechanisms_present.description: Whether any known mechanisms (e.g., debug flags, admin backdoors, unauthenticated overrides) exist that allow actions to bypass RBAC enforcement

sod_constraints_defined.title: Separation of Duties Constraints Defined
sod_constraints_defined.description: Whether the system has formally defined mutually exclusive role constraints that prevent any single user from holding conflicting permissions (e.g., requestor and approver roles cannot be assigned to the same user)

sod_enforcement_mode.title: SoD Enforcement Mode
sod_enforcement_mode.description: Whether SoD constraints are enforced automatically by the system (preventive) or only reported/alerted (detective), or not enforced at all

sod_violation_count.title: Current SoD Violation Count
sod_violation_count.description: Number of users currently assigned to at least one pair of mutually exclusive roles, indicating active violations of defined SoD constraints

dual_control_workflows_enabled.title: Dual-Control Workflows Enabled
dual_control_workflows_enabled.description: Whether critical workflows (e.g., financial transactions, privileged access grants, configuration changes) require approval from a second user who does not share the initiating role

access_decision_logging_enabled.title: Access Decision Logging Enabled
access_decision_logging_enabled.description: Whether the application logs both granted and denied RBAC access decisions to an audit trail

logged_decision_types.title: Logged Decision Types
logged_decision_types.description: The types of access decisions that are logged (e.g., 'granted', 'denied', 'both')

log_includes_user_and_resource.title: Log Includes User Identity and Resource
log_includes_user_and_resource.description: Whether each access decision log entry captures the user identity, the resource or action attempted, and the role evaluated

role_creation_process_defined.title: Role Creation Process Defined
role_creation_process_defined.description: Whether a formal, documented process exists for creating new roles, including approval requirements and permission scoping guidelines

role_retirement_process_defined.title: Role Retirement Process Defined
role_retirement_process_defined.description: Whether a formal process exists for retiring or decommissioning roles, including user reassignment steps and permission cleanup to prevent permission accumulation

role_review_frequency.title: Role Review Frequency
role_review_frequency.description: How frequently existing roles are reviewed for relevance, permission accuracy, and alignment with current organizational requirements

orphaned_roles_present.title: Orphaned Roles Present
orphaned_roles_present.description: Whether roles exist in the system that have no assigned users and no documented purpose or scheduled deletion, indicating lifecycle management gaps

centralized_enforcement_point_exists.title: Centralized Enforcement Point Exists
centralized_enforcement_point_exists.description: Whether the application has a single, centralized location (middleware, gateway, or policy engine) where RBAC permissions are evaluated before granting access to application modules

per_feature_permission_logic_present.title: Per-Feature Permission Logic Present
per_feature_permission_logic_present.description: Whether individual application modules or features contain their own inline permission checks that are not delegated to the centralized enforcement point, indicating fragmented access control

enforcement_coverage_scope.title: Enforcement Coverage Scope
enforcement_coverage_scope.description: The breadth of application modules and endpoints covered by the centralized RBAC enforcement point

privileged_roles_defined.title: Privileged Roles Defined
privileged_roles_defined.description: Whether the application has explicitly defined roles (e.g., admin, data-exporter, auditor) that gate destructive or sensitive operations such as deletion, bulk export, and administrative configuration changes

sensitive_operations_role_enforced.title: Sensitive Operations Role Enforcement
sensitive_operations_role_enforced.description: Indicates whether role checks are enforced on all sensitive/destructive operations (delete, export, admin config), only partially enforced on some, or not enforced at all

standard_user_privilege_separation.title: Standard User Privilege Separation Enforced
standard_user_privilege_separation.description: Whether standard (non-privileged) user roles are explicitly denied or not granted the ability to perform destructive or sensitive operations, enforcing clear separation from privileged roles

idp_sync_enabled.title: Identity Provider Sync Enabled
idp_sync_enabled.description: Whether automatic synchronization of role assignments from the authoritative identity provider (e.g., LDAP, SCIM, Azure AD) is enabled

sync_frequency_minutes.title: Role Sync Frequency (Minutes)
sync_frequency_minutes.description: How frequently (in minutes) role memberships are synchronized from the identity provider. Lower values reduce the window where stale permissions persist.

deprovisioning_action.title: Deprovisioning Action on User Removal
deprovisioning_action.description: The action taken on a user's application roles when the user is removed or disabled in the identity provider

role_review_process_enabled.title: Role Review Process Enabled
role_review_process_enabled.description: Indicates whether a formal periodic role review and recertification process is in place for RBAC assignments

review_frequency_days.title: Review Frequency (Days)
review_frequency_days.description: Maximum number of days between mandatory role assignment reviews/recertification cycles

last_review_completed_days_ago.title: Days Since Last Review Completed
last_review_completed_days_ago.description: Number of days elapsed since the most recent completed role recertification cycle

revocation_action_supported.title: Revocation Action Supported in Review Workflow
revocation_action_supported.description: Indicates whether the review process supports and enforces actual revocation of roles when managers deny/reject an assignment during recertification

review_scope.title: Review Scope
review_scope.description: Describes the breadth of roles and users covered by the recertification process
